headline: Taiwan says Chinese pressure over the island is the 'new normal'
context: Taiwan's Foreign Ministry on Tuesday said the scholars' passports and mobile phones were confiscated, and they were detained in Mombasa for more than 20 hours before being allowed to leave the country.
